🎬 Da 5 Bloods (2020) — War, Drama
Da 5 Bloods (2020) follows four African American Vietnam War veterans who return to Vietnam decades after the war. Their mission is personal: they want to recover the remains of their fallen squad leader and search for a hidden fortune they left behind.
As the former soldiers journey through the country, old memories and unresolved wounds begin to surface. What starts as a search for their past soon becomes a dangerous confrontation with the consequences of war, forcing them to face the choices they made and the losses they never fully escaped.
The film explores themes of brotherhood, trauma, racism, loyalty, greed, and the lasting impact of war. It shows how the battlefield can remain part of a person's life long after the fighting has ended.
More than just a war adventure, Da 5 Bloods is a story about friendship, history, and the emotional price of carrying the past for decades. ❤️‍🩹
💬 Do you think people can ever truly leave the past behind? Let us know in the comments! 👇

source_details.synopsis: Da 5 Bloods is a 2020 American war drama film directed, produced, and co-written by Spike Lee. It stars Delroy Lindo, Jonathan Majors, Clarke Peters, Johnny Trí Nguyễn, Norm Lewis, Isiah Whitlock Jr., Mélanie Thierry, Paul Walter Hauser, Jasper Pääkkönen, Jean Reno and Chadwick Boseman (in his last film to be released during his lifetime).The film's plot follows a group of four aging Vietnam War veterans who return to the country in search of the remains of their fallen squad leader, as well as the treasure they buried while serving there.
